item.title: The Card That Makes Eating Safely in Japan Easier
item.description: A written Japanese dietary card is often more reliable than speaking when you have coeliac disease, a food allergy, or follow halal or vegan diets. Here's exactly what to put on it, how to phrase it using checked Japanese, and how to hand it to staff so your request reaches the kitchen - not just the waiter.
